title: Data Strategies for Large Language Models: A Unified Perspective on the Training Lifecycle
abstract: arXiv:2610.21681v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Data strategy plays a central role in training large language models (LLMs). It governs the selection, weighting, and scheduling of training data, thereby determining the capabilities a model can acquire from a fixed data budget. We treat high-quality data as having high training-dependent utility, which depends on the target objective, the model, and its training state rather than on the text alone. Research in this area now spans pretraining and post-training, but related ideas use inconsistent terminology and evaluation protocols. This work reviews data strategies across the training lifecycle and formulates them as policies that allocate a training budget over candidate examples. We organise methods by their decision granularity, model dependence, and temporal adaptivity, then compare their computational requirements and empirical support. translated_title: 大语言模型的数据策略：训练生命周期的统一视角
translated_abstract: 数据策略在大语言模型（LLM）的训练中扮演着核心角色。它支配着训练数据的选择、加权和调度，从而决定模型在固定数据预算下能够获得哪些能力。我们将高质量数据视为具有高“训练依赖效用”的数据，这种效用取决于目标训练目标、模型本身及其训练状态，而不仅仅取决于文本本身。该领域的研究现已涵盖预训练和后训练阶段，但相关研究使用了不一致的术语和评估协议。本工作回顾了覆盖整个训练生命周期的数据策略，并将其形式化为在候选样本上分配训练预算的策略。我们按照决策粒度、模型依赖性和时间自适应性对这些方法进行组织归类，进而比较它们的计算需求和实证支持。细粒度或依赖训练状态的策略能够提供更强的控制能力，但会带来额外的评分和搜索开销。
tldr: 本文提出了一个统一框架，将大语言模型在预训练与后训练全生命周期中的各类数据策略形式化为“在候选样本上分配训练预算的策略”，并按决策粒度、模型依赖性和时间自适应性三个维度对现有方法进行系统分类与比较。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified framework that formulates data strategies across the entire LLM training lifecycle (both pretraining and post-training) as policies for allocating training budgets over candidate examples, systematically organizing and comparing existing methods by decision granularity, model dependence, and temporal adaptivity.
